what: quần đùi bơi nam: a man of Bãi Trước in swim shorts, with no shirt and bare feet (an order of the person blueprint of World that wears the shorts)
uses: Plan 0026, R10: the men who swim at Bãi Trước at 17:00, without a shirt, on the sand and in the water.

sources.date: 2019-04-30 (in the file name of the photo)
sources.author: Đông Hà / Tuổi Trẻ
sources.shows: Bãi Trước at the end of the afternoon of a holiday, to the south. A man with no shirt walks on the wet sand in black loose shorts that end a little above the knee; other men in the water in black shorts, some with white stripes at the sides. The file is a crop of the man in black shorts.

sources.author: Trường Hà / VnExpress
sources.shows: The south part of Bãi Trước full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon. Men with no shirt in swim shorts: dark checks, navy, dark green, grey checks; most end at the middle of the thigh. The file is a crop of a man in dark check shorts on the sand.

sources.author: Trường Hà / VnExpress
sources.shows: Bãi Sau of Vũng Tàu (the other beach of the town, 2 km away) on the same afternoon: many men with no shirt in swim shorts. Black, dark grey and grey check shorts; some end high on the thigh, most at the middle of the thigh. The file is a crop of three men.

height_of_person.source: estimate (no source): the person of World with the height 0.5 (a man of 35 years). The sizes of the shorts scale with the body.

length.source: Photo 0: the man in black shorts is 840 px from his feet to the top of his head (1.65 m); his shorts are 250 px from the waist band to the hem: 0.49 m. Photos 1 and 2: on men of 215 px (1.65 m), shorts of 28 px to 50 px: 0.21 m to 0.38 m. Most shorts end between the middle of the thigh and a little above the knee: 0.35 m to 0.49 m. I use 0.42 m.

fit.source: Photos 0 and 1: the legs of the shorts stand away from the thigh; how much: estimate (no source).

colors.source: Photo 0: black, some with white stripes; photos 1 and 2: dark checks, navy, dark green, grey checks. One color for each man.

shirt_and_feet.source: Photos 0, 1 and 2: the men in the water and on the wet sand have no shirt and no shoes.
